Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect on [AncientGarurumon] itself?

Card Q&A.a: Up to 2 total of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in their names or your [Hybrid] trait Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are unsuspended by this card's [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] You may unsuspend up to 2 of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in their names or [Hybrid] in their forms.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 blue level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Hybrid] in its form from your hand without paying its memory cost.
